name: geochannel-workspace
description: Open-source backend and JavaScript SDK for viewport-scoped geospatial streams

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix web run test:unit && npm --prefix examples/token-broker test
scripts.check:structure: npm --prefix backend run check:structure && npm --prefix web run check:structure
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:structure
